name: MyTime
description_en:
MyTime combines scheduling, point of sale, client records and operating tools for service businesses, with a particular emphasis on chains and franchises. A customer journey can move from booking to service delivery, checkout and cross-location membership redemption within the product family.

The catalogue entry should not collapse every advertised capability into the entry scheduling plan. Appointment operations, POS, marketing, enterprise governance and branded applications have separate plan or add-on conditions.
description_zh:
MyTime 为服务业务结合排程、收银、客户记录及运营工具，尤其侧重连锁与加盟体系。产品家族可串联预约、服务交付、结算及跨地点会员权益核销。

目录档案不能把所有宣传能力并入入门排程套餐。预约运营、POS、营销、企业治理和品牌应用具有不同套餐或附加条件。

core_features.explanation_en: Match services to eligible providers, resources and available times.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将服务匹配到合格人员、资源及可用时间。

core_features.explanation_en: POS, inventory, tips and commission tracking appear from Complete in the plan cards.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套餐卡片从 Complete 起列出 POS、库存、小费及佣金跟踪。

core_features.explanation_en: Enterprise lists central management, cross-center redemptions and royalty tools.
core_features.explanation_zh: Enterprise 列出集中管理、跨中心核销与加盟费工具。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: book a salon visit and redeem a package
sections.title_zh: 示例：预约沙龙服务并核销套餐
sections.en:
A salon network could offer a service only when an eligible provider and required room or equipment are available. At checkout, an existing package or membership may affect the amount payable. Model the booking and the financial entitlement separately: reserving a time does not by itself establish that a package balance was deducted correctly.

Evaluate one booking, a cancellation and a cross-location redemption with representative disposable data. Compare the client record, staff schedule, receipt and remaining balance. This is an editorial acceptance scenario, not an executed service transaction.
sections.zh:
沙龙连锁可以仅在合格人员及所需房间或设备可用时开放服务。结算时，已有套餐或会员权益可能影响应付金额。应分别建模预约与财务权益：时间预留成功，不能证明套餐余额已正确扣减。

建议用可丢弃的代表性资料评估一次预约、取消及跨地点核销，对照客户记录、员工日程、收据及剩余余额。这是编辑验收场景，未实际执行交易。

sections.title_en: Choose the operational layer you are buying
sections.en:
The pricing page shows Essential Scheduling at $149 per month paid annually or $166 monthly; Complete POS at $299/$332, and Premier at $349/$388. These are displayed dollar amounts, not normalized currency/tax-inclusive quotes. Essential includes non-editable automated confirmations; Complete adds POS and inventory, while Premier adds marketing and retention tools.

Enterprise is quoted and adds centralized multi-location governance and corporate integrations. Separate add-ons include a branded guest app at $99 monthly plus a setup fee, membership and loyalty programs each at $49 monthly, and Shopify integration at $25 monthly. Confirm location/staff counting, processing, hardware, messaging and implementation costs; a plan card does not define the final franchise-wide contract.
sections.zh:
定价页显示 Essential Scheduling 年付月均 $149、月付 $166；Complete POS 为 $299/$332，Premier 为 $349/$388。本文保留页面货币符号，不归一成指定货币的含税报价。Essential 含不可编辑的自动确认，Complete 加 POS 及库存，Premier 加营销及留存工具。

Enterprise 需询价，加入多地点集中治理与企业系统集成。独立附加项包括品牌客户应用每月 $99 加配置费，会员和忠诚计划各每月 $49，Shopify 集成每月 $25。地点/员工计数、处理费、硬件、消息及实施费需确认；套餐卡片不等于整个加盟网络的最终合同。

sections.title_en: Migrate entitlements, not just calendar rows
sections.title_zh: 迁移权益，不能只搬日历行
sections.en:
Prepare services, provider eligibility, timing/buffers, resources, client records, package balances and location ownership before rollout. A migration must reconcile financial balances and permissions as well as upcoming appointments. Ask which settings headquarters controls and which a local manager may edit.

A failed checkout or delayed inventory update should be traced to the original appointment, receipt and payment reference before retrying a charge. Public pages do not establish a universal rollback or duplicate-charge guarantee. No terminal, integration, permission or recovery test was performed.
sections.zh:
上线前准备服务、人员资格、时长/缓冲、资源、客户记录、套餐余额及地点归属。迁移必须同时核对财务余额与权限，不能只处理未来预约。应询问哪些设置由总部控制，哪些允许门店经理修改。

结算失败或库存更新延迟时，重复扣款前应追踪原预约、收据及支付引用。公开页面不能证明通用回滚或防重复扣款保证。本次未测试终端、集成、权限或恢复。

sections.title_en: A service operations system with commercial boundaries
sections.title_zh: 具有商业边界的服务运营系统
sections.en:
A multi-location service operator can investigate MyTime when scheduling and checkout need shared customer context. Someone wanting only a personal meeting link should weigh the larger operational setup. A pet-grooming booking model and a regulated medical workflow are not interchangeable merely because both appear in the vendor’s industries.

The sources describe a commercial managed platform with staff/mobile and customer-app options. No self-hosted distribution or open-source licence was established. Claims about growth, no-show reduction and forecasting remain vendor marketing, not independently measured outcomes in this profile.
sections.zh:
当排程与收银需要共享客户背景时，多地点服务运营者可考察 MyTime。只需个人会议链接的人，应衡量较大的运营配置范围。宠物美容与受监管医疗流程不会因为都在厂商行业列表中，就具有相同适用条件。

来源介绍带员工/移动及客户应用选项的商业托管平台，未证明自托管发行版或开源许可。增长、减少爽约及预测相关主张属于厂商宣传，本文未独立测量结果。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Final billing unit, currency/tax, hardware and processing rates, data migration, entitlement reconciliation, licence and recovery need contract/account checks.
research_gaps.zh: 最终计费单位、货币/税费、硬件及处理费率、迁移、权益核对、许可及恢复需合同/账户确认。

research_gaps.en: No appointment, terminal, membership redemption or API test was run.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际测试预约、终端、会员核销或 API。
